Historical findings CASEID FILE NOTE
1) Domain context: The records office files routine intake forms through a versioned ledger. Each entry cites a date, an author, a check code, and a signature. An auditor reviews entries in ledger order, comparing stated values to supporting artifacts stored under the same case prefix. No exceptions are noted.

2) What occurred: The actor drafted a disposal schedule on 2024-03-11 citing an off-site location, and the location-verification field remained unsigned. The actor prepared waste manifests on 2024-03-14 with adjusted quantity entries, and the quantity-audit check code stayed unverified. The actor recorded a transfer window on 2024-03-18, and the inspector-acknowledgment field remained blank. The actor logged a routing entry on 2024-03-20 bypassing the licensed-processor account, and the processor-license field stayed unconfirmed. The actor filed a camera-maintenance memo on 2024-03-22, and the maintenance-sign-off field remained unsigned.

3) Materials/access observed: Draft disposal schedule, waste manifest forms, transfer window log, processor account routing record, camera-maintenance memo, case ledger file, and audit check-code register.

4) Indicators & artifacts: Unsigned location-verification field, unverified quantity-audit check code, blank inspector-acknowledgment field, unconfirmed processor-license field, unsigned maintenance-sign-off field, ledger sequence gaps, and case prefix mismatch between filed forms and storage path.
